messages:
Priya: Quick note — noticed multiple console tiles use different phrasing for the same 429/500 events. Confusing for customers.
Ajay: Where exactly? Can you point to an example?
Priya: Console: "Rate limit hit" vs API body: `quota_exceeded`. SDK surfaces "try_later" in some helpers.
Maria: Oof. We should separate machine codes from human copy. Machine: `quota_exceeded`. Human: "Youxceeded your quota". But that still leaves inconsistent badges.
Sam: Proposal: Add two canonical fields in error payload: `internal_code` and `user_message`. SDKs map `user_message` -> toast/badge, `internal_code` -> telemetry.
Ajay: Also add `suggested_action` (string) for quick client hints: "retry-after:30", "switch-model:small" or "contact-support".
Priya: Love `suggested_action`. Could be structured later but keep as freeform for now.
Maria: For console UX: surface `user_message` on hover and have a short badge taxonomy: info, warning, partial, critical. Map them to exposure levels: low, medium, high, critical.
Sam: We need a mapping table. Example rows: HTTP 429 -> internal_code=RATE_LIMIT, user_message="Quota exceeded", suggested_action="retry-after" -> badge=warning/exposure=medium. HTTP 503 transient -> internal_code=SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE, user_message="Temporary service issue, retry" -> badge=partial/exposure=low.
Ajay: Important: don't change existing `internal_code` values now. Ship a compatibility mapping layer that translates old codes to new lexicon for older SDKs.
Priya: Telemetry ask: tag events with `exposure_level` and `error_origin` (eg runtime|routing|quota|model) and emit `client_hint_used` boolean if SDK acted on suggested_action.
Maria: Dashboards: 1) exposure_level by customer 2) % of errors that included a `suggested_action` 3) failed retries within 60s. Add a retrospective panel for rollout.
Sam: Rollout: feature-flag the `user_message` surface and `suggested_action` output. Start with internal customers, then 5% prod, then 25/50/100. If `client_hint_used` is high -> proceed faster.
Ajay: SDK work: surface both fields and add helpers: parseRetryAfter(), preferFallbackModel(). Add tests for older-code mappings.
Priya: Docs action: update API reference with payload examples and console copy guidelines (short vs expanded message). Who takes docs?
Maria: I'll take console copy PR. Priya you can do API reference update?
Priya: On it. Will include example payloads for JS/PY/Go.
deploy-bot: PR created: https://git.internal/repos/redwood/api-docs/pulls/142 (auto)
Sam: Devops note: add log enrichment so we can trace internal_code -> route -> node without increasing log volume. Maybe sample 1/10 for verbose logs.
Ajay: Good call. Also ensure rate-limited routes include tenant_id in telemetry for quota diagnostics.
Maria: Edge case: some customers rely on parsing specific strings today. We must clearly announce deprecation plan for those brittle integrations.
Priya: Add deprecation note in RFC. Also provide a small migration shim in SDKs.
Sam: Next steps checklist: RFC (Priya), SDK PR (Ajay), Console copy PR (Maria), Docs PR (Priya), Telemetry dashboard (Sam). Flagging blockers: migration shim and canary gating.
Maria: Meeting to sync handoff tomorrow 9:30am in #eng-platform. Thanks all.
